summary: +1 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls; Calm Emotions (DC 15) once per dawn.
text: +1 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls; Calm Emotions (DC 15) once per dawn. Reference-only, each once per dawn: Magic action creates a 30-foot aura for 1 minute, forcing chosen visible entrants or end-turn occupants to save DC 15 Wisdom or be Frightened until their next turn starts. Reaction when a creature enters 5 feet pushes chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation up to 30 feet away on a failed DC 15 Strength save.
